# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** twenty  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015), [v3 ch.Life P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) (sibling), [Nettie Blewett](../character/nettie-blewett.md) (spouse)

## Appearance

Billy Andrews is a big, fat, and stolid youth who possesses a broad, round, and expressionless freckled face. Characterized by his good-natured demeanor, he is frequently seen with a perpetual smile or grin.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 ch.Autumn P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004), [v3 ch.Proposal P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006)_

## Personality

Billy Andrews is a round-faced, good-natured fellow who is known for being a great worker with no bad habits. He is described as stupid, perpetually smiling, and extremely shy.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Proposal P6](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0006), [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 ch.Proposal P15](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0015)_

## History

Billy Andrews drove [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) home from a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) performed successfully. He later had the upper farm given to him in his own name by his father, leaving him in a position where he was free to marry.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P38](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0038), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P39](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P41](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0041), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P48](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0048), [v3 ch.Proposal P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)_

## Relationships

### [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/billy-andrews--jane-andrews.md)

Billy is Jane's brother. He acts as a driver for [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md) and her friends, taking her, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) home following a benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P27](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0027), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIII. The Hotel Concert P38](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0038), +5 more_
